passages.text: These are the journeys of the Israelites when they came out of the land of Egypt by their divisions under the leadership of Moses and Aaron.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites left Egypt.
They traveled in groups.
Moses led them.
Aaron also led them.
These are the journeys they made.
passages.original: אֵ֜לֶּה מַסְעֵ֣י בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָצְא֛וּ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם לְצִבְאֹתָ֑ם בְּיַד־ מֹשֶׁ֖ה וְאַהֲרֹֽן׃

passages.text: At the LORD’s command, Moses recorded the stages of their journey. These are the stages listed by their starting points: On the fifteenth day of the first month, on the day after the Passover, the Israelites set out from Rameses. They marched out defiantly in full view of all the Egyptians, who were burying all their firstborn, whom the LORD had struck down among them; for the LORD had executed judgment against their gods.
passages.sermon:
Moses led the Israelites.
The LORD commanded Moses.
Moses wrote down the stages of the Israelites’ journey.
He listed each stage by its starting point.
The Israelites left Rameses.
They left on the fifteenth day of the first month.
This was the day after the Passover.
The Israelites marched out boldly.
All the Egyptians saw them leave.
The Egyptians were burying their firstborn sons.
The LORD had struck down all the firstborn of Egypt.
The LORD had judged the gods of Egypt.
passages.original: וַיִּכְתֹּ֨ב מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶת־ מוֹצָאֵיהֶ֛ם לְמַסְעֵיהֶ֖ם עַל־ פִּ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְאֵ֥לֶּה מַסְעֵיהֶ֖ם לְמוֹצָאֵיהֶֽם׃ וַיִּסְע֤וּ מֵֽרַעְמְסֵס֙ בַּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָֽרִאשׁ֔וֹן בַּחֲמִשָּׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֛ר י֖וֹם לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֑וֹן מִֽמָּחֳרַ֣ת הַפֶּ֗סַח יָצְא֤וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּיָ֣ד רָמָ֔ה לְעֵינֵ֖י כָּל־ מִצְרָֽיִם׃ וּמִצְרַ֣יִם מְקַבְּרִ֗ים אֵת֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִכָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה בָּהֶ֖ם כָּל־ בְּכ֑וֹר וּבֵאלֹ֣הֵיהֶ֔ם עָשָׂ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה שְׁפָטִֽים׃

passages.text: The Israelites set out from Rameses and camped at Succoth.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites were God's chosen people.
Moses and Aaron led the Israelites.
The Israelites left Rameses.
They traveled together.
They camped at Succoth.
passages.original: וַיִּסְע֥וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵרַעְמְסֵ֑ס וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּסֻכֹּֽת׃

passages.text: They set out from Succoth and camped at Etham, on the edge of the wilderness.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites left Succoth.
They traveled to Etham.
Etham was at the edge of the wilderness.
They camped at Etham.
passages.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִסֻּכֹּ֑ת וַיַּחֲנ֣וּ בְאֵתָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר בִּקְצֵ֥ה הַמִּדְבָּֽר׃

passages.text: They set out from Etham and turned back to Pi-hahiroth, opposite Baal-zephon, and they camped near Migdol.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites were a people whom God led out of Egypt.
They left the place called Etham.
They turned back toward a place called Pi-hahiroth.
Pi-hahiroth was opposite a place called Baal-zephon.
They camped near a place called Migdol.
passages.original: וַיִּסְעוּ֙ מֵֽאֵתָ֔ם וַיָּ֙שָׁב֙ עַל־ פִּ֣י הַחִירֹ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־ פְּנֵ֖י בַּ֣עַל צְפ֑וֹן וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ לִפְנֵ֥י מִגְדֹּֽל׃

passages.text: They set out from Pi-hahiroth and crossed through the sea, into the wilderness, and they journeyed three days into the Wilderness of Etham and camped at Marah.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites left Pi-hahiroth.
They crossed through the sea.
They entered the wilderness.
They traveled for three days in the Wilderness of Etham.
They camped at Marah.
passages.original: וַיִּסְעוּ֙ מִפְּנֵ֣י הַֽחִירֹ֔ת וַיַּֽעַבְר֥וּ בְתוֹךְ־ הַיָּ֖ם הַמִּדְבָּ֑רָה וַיֵּ֨לְכ֜וּ דֶּ֣רֶךְ שְׁלֹ֤שֶׁת יָמִים֙ בְּמִדְבַּ֣ר אֵתָ֔ם וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּמָרָֽה׃

passages.text: They set out from Marah and came to Elim, where there were twelve springs and seventy palm trees, and they camped there.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites left Marah.
They traveled to Elim.
Elim had twelve springs of water.
Elim had seventy palm trees.
The Israelites camped at Elim.
passages.original: וַיִּסְעוּ֙ מִמָּרָ֔ה וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ אֵילִ֑מָה וּ֠בְאֵילִם שְׁתֵּ֣ים עֶשְׂרֵ֞ה עֵינֹ֥ת מַ֛יִם וְשִׁבְעִ֥ים תְּמָרִ֖ים וַיַּחֲנוּ־ שָֽׁם׃

passages.text: They set out from Elim and camped by the Red Sea.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites left Elim.
They traveled away from Elim.
They camped by the Red Sea.
They stopped and stayed near the Red Sea.
passages.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵאֵילִ֑ם וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ עַל־ יַם־ סֽוּף׃

passages.text: They set out from the Red Sea and camped in the Desert of Sin.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites left the Red Sea.
They traveled together.
They arrived at the Desert of Sin.
They set up camp in the Desert of Sin.
passages.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִיַּם־ ס֑וּף וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּמִדְבַּר־ סִֽין׃

passages.text: They set out from the Desert of Sin and camped at Dophkah.
passages.sermon: The Israelites traveled in the wilderness.\r\nThey left the Desert of Sin.\r\nThey camped at Dophkah.
passages.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִמִּדְבַּר־ סִ֑ין וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּדָפְקָֽה׃

passages.text: They set out from Dophkah and camped at Alush.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites traveled together in the wilderness.
They left the place called Dophkah.
They set out on their journey.
They stopped and camped at a place called Alush.
passages.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִדָּפְקָ֑ה וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּאָלֽוּשׁ׃

passages.text: They set out from Alush and camped at Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites traveled together in the wilderness.
They left the place called Alush.
They went to a place called Rephidim.
They camped at Rephidim.
There was no water at Rephidim.
The people had nothing to drink.
passages.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵאָל֑וּשׁ וַֽיַּחֲנוּ֙ בִּרְפִידִ֔ם וְלֹא־ הָ֨יָה שָׁ֥ם מַ֛יִם לָעָ֖ם לִשְׁתּֽוֹת׃

passages.text: They set out from Rephidim and camped in the Wilderness of Sinai.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites left Rephidim.
They traveled together as a group.
They camped in the Wilderness of Sinai.
The Wilderness of Sinai is a desert area.
The Israelites stayed there as a community.
passages.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵרְפִידִ֑ם וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּמִדְבַּ֥ר סִינָֽי׃

passages.text: They set out from the Wilderness of Sinai and camped at Kibroth-hattaavah.
passages.sermon: The Israelites traveled in the wilderness.\r\nThey left the Wilderness of Sinai.\r\nThey camped at Kibroth-hattaavah.
passages.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִמִּדְבַּ֣ר סִינָ֑י וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּקִבְרֹ֥ת הַֽתַּאֲוָֽה׃

passages.text: They set out from Kibroth-hattaavah and camped at Hazeroth.
passages.sermon: The Israelites traveled together in the wilderness.\r\nThey left Kibroth-hattaavah.\r\nThey camped at Hazeroth.
passages.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִקִּבְרֹ֣ת הַֽתַּאֲוָ֑ה וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בַּחֲצֵרֹֽת׃

passages.text: They set out from Hazeroth and camped at Rithmah.
passages.sermon: The Israelites traveled together in the wilderness.\r\nThey left Hazeroth.\r\nThey camped at Rithmah.
passages.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵחֲצֵרֹ֑ת וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּרִתְמָֽה׃

passages.text: They set out from Rithmah and camped at Rimmon-perez.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites traveled in the wilderness.
They left the place called Rithmah.
They set out from Rithmah.
They stopped at a new place.
They camped at Rimmon-perez.
passages.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵרִתְמָ֑ה וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּרִמֹּ֥ן פָּֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: They set out from Rimmon-perez and camped at Libnah.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites traveled in the wilderness.
They left Rimmon-perez.
They camped at Libnah.
passages.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵרִמֹּ֣ן פָּ֑רֶץ וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּלִבְנָֽה׃

passages.text: They set out from Libnah and camped at Rissah.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites traveled in the wilderness.
They left Libnah.
They camped at Rissah.
passages.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִלִּבְנָ֑ה וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּרִסָּֽה׃

passages.text: They set out from Rissah and camped at Kehelathah.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites traveled in the wilderness.
They left Rissah.
They camped at Kehelathah.
passages.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵרִסָּ֑ה וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בִּקְהֵלָֽתָה׃

passages.text: They set out from Kehelathah and camped at Mount Shepher.
passages.sermon: The Israelites traveled in the wilderness.\r\nThey left Kehelathah.\r\nThey camped at Mount Shepher.
passages.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִקְּהֵלָ֑תָה וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּהַר־ שָֽׁפֶר׃

passages.text: They set out from Mount Shepher and camped at Haradah.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites traveled in the wilderness.
They left Mount Shepher.
They set out from that place.
They camped at Haradah.
They stopped and stayed there.
passages.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵֽהַר־ שָׁ֑פֶר וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בַּחֲרָדָֽה׃

passages.text: They set out from Haradah and camped at Makheloth.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites traveled in the wilderness.
They left a place called Haradah.
They set out from Haradah.
They stopped at a new place.
They camped at Makheloth.
passages.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵחֲרָדָ֑ה וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּמַקְהֵלֹֽת׃

passages.text: They set out from Makheloth and camped at Tahath.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites traveled in the wilderness.
They left Makheloth.
They camped at Tahath.
passages.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִמַּקְהֵלֹ֑ת וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּתָֽחַת׃

passages.text: They set out from Tahath and camped at Terah.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites traveled together in the wilderness.
They left the place called Tahath.
They went to a new place called Terah.
They set up camp at Terah.
passages.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִתָּ֑חַת וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּתָֽרַח׃

passages.text: They set out from Terah and camped at Mithkah.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites traveled in the wilderness.
They left a place called Terah.
They set out on their journey.
They stopped and camped at a place called Mithkah.
passages.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִתָּ֑רַח וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּמִתְקָֽה׃

passages.text: They set out from Mithkah and camped at Hashmonah.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites traveled in the wilderness.
They left Mithkah.
They camped at Hashmonah.
passages.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִמִּתְקָ֑ה וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּחַשְׁמֹנָֽה׃

passages.text: They set out from Hashmonah and camped at Moseroth.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites traveled in the wilderness.
They left Hashmonah.
They camped at Moseroth.
passages.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵֽחַשְׁמֹנָ֑ה וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּמֹסֵרֽוֹת׃

passages.text: They set out from Moseroth and camped at Bene-jaakan.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites traveled in the wilderness.
They left Moseroth.
They camped at Bene-jaakan.
passages.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִמֹּסֵר֑וֹת וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בִּבְנֵ֥י יַעֲקָֽן׃

passages.text: They set out from Bene-jaakan and camped at Hor-haggidgad.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites traveled in the wilderness.
They left Bene-jaakan.
They camped at Hor-haggidgad.
passages.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִבְּנֵ֣י יַעֲקָ֑ן וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּחֹ֥ר הַגִּדְגָּֽד׃

passages.text: They set out from Hor-haggidgad and camped at Jotbathah.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites traveled in the wilderness.
They left Hor-haggidgad.
They camped at Jotbathah.
passages.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵחֹ֣ר הַגִּדְגָּ֑ד וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּיָטְבָֽתָה׃

passages.text: They set out from Jotbathah and camped at Abronah.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites traveled in the wilderness.
They left Jotbathah.
They set out from that place.
They camped at Abronah.
They stopped and stayed there.
passages.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִיָּטְבָ֑תָה וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּעַבְרֹנָֽה׃

passages.text: They set out from Abronah and camped at Ezion-geber.
passages.sermon: The Israelites traveled together in the wilderness.\r\nThey left Abronah.\r\nThey camped at Ezion-geber.
passages.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵֽעַבְרֹנָ֑ה וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּעֶצְי֥וֹן גָּֽבֶר׃

passages.text: They set out from Ezion-geber and camped at Kadesh in the Wilderness of Zin.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites traveled together in the wilderness.
They left Ezion-geber.
They camped at Kadesh.
Kadesh is in the Wilderness of Zin.
passages.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵעֶצְי֣וֹן גָּ֑בֶר וַיַּחֲנ֥וּ בְמִדְבַּר־ צִ֖ן הִ֥וא קָדֵֽשׁ׃

passages.text: They set out from Kadesh and camped at Mount Hor, on the outskirts of the land of Edom.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites left Kadesh.
They traveled to Mount Hor.
Mount Hor is on the edge of the land of Edom.
The Israelites camped at Mount Hor.
passages.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִקָּדֵ֑שׁ וַֽיַּחֲנוּ֙ בְּהֹ֣ר הָהָ֔ר בִּקְצֵ֖ה אֶ֥רֶץ אֱדֽוֹם׃

passages.text: At the LORD’s command, Aaron the priest climbed Mount Hor and died there on the first day of the fifth month, in the fortieth year after the Israelites had come out of the land of Egypt.
passages.sermon:
Aaron was the priest of Israel.
The LORD gave Aaron a command.
Aaron climbed Mount Hor.
Aaron died there on Mount Hor.
This happened in the fortieth year after the Israelites left Egypt.
Aaron died on the first day of the fifth month.
passages.original: וַיַּעַל֩ אַהֲרֹ֨ן הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֶל־ הֹ֥ר הָהָ֛ר עַל־ פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה וַיָּ֣מָת שָׁ֑ם בִּשְׁנַ֣ת הָֽאַרְבָּעִ֗ים לְצֵ֤את בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם בַּחֹ֥דֶשׁ הַחֲמִישִׁ֖י בְּאֶחָ֥ד לַחֹֽדֶשׁ׃

passages.text: Aaron was 123 years old when he died on Mount Hor.
passages.sermon: Aaron was a priest of Israel.\r\nAaron died on Mount Hor.\r\nAaron was 123 years old when he died.
passages.original: וְאַהֲרֹ֔ן בֶּן־ שָׁלֹ֧שׁ וְעֶשְׂרִ֛ים וּמְאַ֖ת שָׁנָ֑ה בְּמֹת֖וֹ בְּהֹ֥ר הָהָֽר׃ס

passages.text: Now the Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the Negev in the land of Canaan, heard that the Israelites were coming.
passages.sermon:
The king of Arad was a Canaanite.
He lived in the Negev.
The Negev is in the land of Canaan.
The king of Arad heard news.
He heard that the Israelites were coming.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֗ע הַֽכְּנַעֲנִי֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ עֲרָ֔ד וְהֽוּא־ יֹשֵׁ֥ב בַּנֶּ֖גֶב בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן בְּבֹ֖א בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: And the Israelites set out from Mount Hor and camped at Zalmonah.
passages.sermon: The Israelites left Mount Hor.\r\nThey traveled together.\r\nThey camped at Zalmonah.
passages.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵהֹ֣ר הָהָ֑ר וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּצַלְמֹנָֽה׃

passages.text: They set out from Zalmonah and camped at Punon.
passages.sermon: The Israelites left Zalmonah.\r\nThey traveled to a new place.\r\nThey camped at Punon.
passages.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִצַּלְמֹנָ֑ה וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּפוּנֹֽן׃

passages.text: They set out from Punon and camped at Oboth.
passages.sermon: The Israelites were traveling in the wilderness.\r\nThey left Punon.\r\nThey camped at Oboth.
passages.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִפּוּנֹ֑ן וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּאֹבֹֽת׃

passages.text: They set out from Oboth and camped at Iye-abarim on the border of Moab.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites traveled together in the wilderness.
They left a place called Oboth.
They moved as a group.
They camped at Iye-abarim.
Iye-abarim was on the border of Moab.
passages.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵאֹבֹ֑ת וַֽיַּחֲנ֛וּ בְּעִיֵּ֥י הָעֲבָרִ֖ים בִּגְב֥וּל מוֹאָֽב׃

passages.text: They set out from Iyim and camped at Dibon-gad.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites traveled together in the wilderness.
They left a place called Iyim.
They set out as a group.
They camped at a new place.
This place was called Dibon-gad.
passages.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵעִיִּ֑ים וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּדִיבֹ֥ן גָּֽד׃

passages.text: They set out from Dibon-gad and camped at Almon-diblathaim.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites traveled together in the wilderness.
They left a place called Dibon-gad.
They set out as a group.
They camped at a place called Almon-diblathaim.
passages.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִדִּיבֹ֣ן גָּ֑ד וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּעַלְמֹ֥ן דִּבְלָתָֽיְמָה׃

passages.text: They set out from Almon-diblathaim and camped in the mountains of Abarim facing Nebo.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites traveled together in the wilderness.
They left a place called Almon-diblathaim.
They moved as a group.
They stopped and set up camp in the mountains of Abarim.
These mountains were across from Nebo.
passages.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵעַלְמֹ֣ן דִּבְלָתָ֑יְמָה וַֽיַּחֲנ֛וּ בְּהָרֵ֥י הָעֲבָרִ֖ים לִפְנֵ֥י נְבֽוֹ׃

passages.text: They set out from the mountains of Abarim and camped on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites traveled from the mountains of Abarim.
They camped on the plains of Moab.
These plains were by the Jordan River.
The camp was across from Jericho.
passages.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵהָרֵ֣י הָעֲבָרִ֑ים וַֽיַּחֲנוּ֙ בְּעַֽרְבֹ֣ת מוֹאָ֔ב עַ֖ל יַרְדֵּ֥ן יְרֵחֽוֹ׃

passages.text: And there on the plains of Moab they camped by the Jordan, from Beth-jeshimoth to Abel-shittim.
passages.sermon: The Israelites camped on the plains of Moab.\r\nThey camped by the Jordan River.\r\nTheir camp stretched from Beth-jeshimoth to Abel-shittim.
passages.original: וַיַּחֲנ֤וּ עַל־ הַיַּרְדֵּן֙ מִבֵּ֣ית הַיְשִׁמֹ֔ת עַ֖ד אָבֵ֣ל הַשִּׁטִּ֑ים בְּעַֽרְבֹ֖ת מוֹאָֽב׃ס

passages.text: On the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho, the LORD said to Moses, “Speak to the Israelites and tell them: When you cross the Jordan into the land of Canaan, you must drive out before you all the inhabitants of the land, destroy all their carved images and cast idols, and demolish all their high places.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
This happened on the plains of Moab.
They were by the Jordan River.
They were across from Jericho.
The LORD gave Moses a command.
The LORD said, "Speak to the Israelites."
The LORD said, "Tell them this."
"You will cross the Jordan River."
"You will enter the land of Canaan."
"You must drive out all the people who live there."
"You must destroy all their carved images."
"You must destroy all their cast idols."
"You must demolish all their high places."
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֖ה בְּעַֽרְבֹ֣ת מוֹאָ֑ב עַל־ יַרְדֵּ֥ן יְרֵח֖וֹ לֵאמֹֽר׃ דַּבֵּר֙ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ אֲלֵהֶ֑ם כִּ֥י אַתֶּ֛ם עֹבְרִ֥ים אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן אֶל־ אֶ֥רֶץ כְּנָֽעַן׃ וְה֨וֹרַשְׁתֶּ֜ם אֶת־ כָּל־ יֹשְׁבֵ֤י הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ מִפְּנֵיכֶ֔ם וְאִ֨בַּדְתֶּ֔ם אֵ֖ת כָּל־ מַשְׂכִּיֹּתָ֑ם וְאֵ֨ת כָּל־ צַלְמֵ֤י מַסֵּֽכֹתָם֙ תְּאַבֵּ֔דוּ וְאֵ֥ת כָּל־ בָּמֹתָ֖ם תַּשְׁמִֽידוּ׃

passages.text: You are to take possession of the land and settle in it, for I have given you the land to possess.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God gave a command to the Israelites.
God said, “You must take the land.
You must live in the land.
I have given this land to you.
You will own the land.
passages.original: וְהוֹרַשְׁתֶּ֥ם אֶת־ הָאָ֖רֶץ וִֽישַׁבְתֶּם־ בָּ֑הּ כִּ֥י לָכֶ֛ם נָתַ֥תִּי אֶת־ הָאָ֖רֶץ לָרֶ֥שֶׁת אֹתָֽהּ׃

passages.text: And you are to divide the land by lot according to your clans. Give a larger inheritance to a larger clan and a smaller inheritance to a smaller one. Whatever falls to each one by lot will be his. You will receive an inheritance according to the tribes of your fathers.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God told Moses to command the Israelites.
The Israelites will enter the land of Canaan.
The Israelites must divide the land among themselves.
They must use lots to divide the land.
Each clan will receive land by lot.
A large clan will receive a large inheritance.
A small clan will receive a small inheritance.
The lot will decide which land each clan receives.
Each clan will keep the land that falls to them by lot.
The Israelites will receive their inheritance according to the tribes of their fathers.
passages.original: וְהִתְנַחַלְתֶּם֩ אֶת־ הָאָ֨רֶץ בְּגוֹרָ֜ל לְמִשְׁפְּחֹֽתֵיכֶ֗ם לָרַ֞ב תַּרְבּ֤וּ אֶת־ נַחֲלָתוֹ֙ וְלַמְעַט֙ תַּמְעִ֣יט אֶת־ נַחֲלָת֔וֹ אֶל֩ אֲשֶׁר־ יֵ֨צֵא ל֥וֹ שָׁ֛מָּה הַגּוֹרָ֖ל ל֣וֹ יִהְיֶ֑ה לְמַטּ֥וֹת אֲבֹתֵיכֶ֖ם תִּתְנֶחָֽלוּ׃

passages.text: But if you do not drive out the inhabitants of the land before you, those you allow to remain will become barbs in your eyes and thorns in your sides; they will harass you in the land where you settle.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the Israelites through Moses.
God gave the Israelites the land of Canaan.
God commanded the Israelites to drive out all the inhabitants of the land.
If you do not drive out the people living in the land,
The people you let remain will hurt you.
They will be like barbs in your eyes.
They will be like thorns in your sides.
They will trouble you in the land where you live.
passages.original: וְאִם־ לֹ֨א תוֹרִ֜ישׁוּ אֶת־ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָאָרֶץ֮ מִפְּנֵיכֶם֒ וְהָיָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תּוֹתִ֣ירוּ מֵהֶ֔ם לְשִׂכִּים֙ בְּעֵ֣ינֵיכֶ֔ם וְלִצְנִינִ֖ם בְּצִדֵּיכֶ֑ם וְצָרֲר֣וּ אֶתְכֶ֔ם עַל־ הָאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתֶּ֖ם יֹשְׁבִ֥ים בָּֽהּ׃

passages.text: And then I will do to you what I had planned to do to them.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the Israelites through Moses.
God warned the Israelites about the people living in Canaan.
God said, “If you do not drive out the inhabitants of the land, I will punish you as I planned to punish them.”
God will do to the Israelites what He intended to do to the Canaanites.
passages.original: וְהָיָ֗ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּמִּ֛יתִי לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת לָהֶ֖ם אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֥ה לָכֶֽם׃פ
